short_description: "Awaken the Forbidden Flavors of the Gods!" Join Lanya, the adorable and charming chef-hero, on a forbidden culinary adventure in another world! Hunt, gather, and cook to grow stronger and challenge the authority of the gods. Cooking is freedom! A roguelike action RPG to satisfy everyone's tastes!
steam_categories: Single-player; Full controller support; Family Sharing
steam_languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
